name: Masaki Narumi
source:
Narumi is one of the first student to talk to [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuuki[/url] just after the "incident". He is kind and have a lot of success with girls, in friendship and, maybe, in love.

In order to respect the rules of the school and avoid expulsion, he sometimes went on a date with his friend [url=https://vndb.org/c21995]Saki[/url]. She now prefer to go with Yuuki but he don't really care because he is more happy to see that Saki have a real date with Yuuki than a fake date with him just for respect the rules of the school. 

He's very kind with girls so he have some other partners for fake dates.
